title: Add 'key' to static widgets like st.link_button, st.popover
body:
### Checklist

- [X] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar feature requests.
- [X] I added a descriptive title and summary to this issue.

### Summary

Most widgets have a `key` parameter - but not `st.link_button`. I can see why - because it is mostly "static", but it's still useful to be able to give an explicit key especially to map a specific style now that key can be used in the element class.

hi [USER]! Can I work on this issue?

Hey [USER]! Thanks for offering to help. I think right now we don't want to do this since (as Arnaud pointed out in his initial post) only interactive widgets have a `key` parameter today. (The only exception to this is `st.container`, where we added `key` to allow CSS hacks on non-widget elements). I think there is a possibility we'll add `key` to more (including static) elements in the future but I'd like to first come up with a consistent model of how we do this before adding it to individual elements here and there. To be clear, this could take us a while because we have other priorities but I'll update here when I get to it!
Wanted to +1 this as I've been wanting to define `key` for st.popover. Also renaming the issue to make it more generic
I'd like to add that it would be helpful for columns too, as I am currently trying to figure out how to give one "max-width" when I cannot target it, due to a lack of "anything" specific about it...
Closing this since `st.link_button` and `st.popover` provide a `key` argument. Adding `key` to other elements is tracked here: #9580
